lines.li: [us] The last exchange with your people ended with a band at our gate.
[them] I know, and I wasn't asked about it.
[them,their:lowtech] Those who planned it were proud of it, and the rest of us were ashamed.
[them] Not everyone at home thought it was clever.
[us] Then tell them we remember who walked out to the gate that day.
[us] Should we expect fighters at the gate the next time we trade captives with you?
[them] Expect what you like, you'll have it anyway.
